The subject of this comparison is Indikator 1, which measures the timeliness of [[antikoagulationsbehandling]] for patients newly diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]]. According to the indicator definition, the metric tracks the proportion of incident patients with a [[cha2ds2-vasc|CHA2DS2-VASc]] score of 2 or higher who initiate oral anticoagulation therapy within a specific timeframe: from 120 days before to 30 days after their first diagnosis date (or discharge date for inpatient stays) [^src2]. Patients with a score below 2, those without residency in [[danmark|Danmark]], and those who die within 30 days of the index date are excluded from the measurement [^src2].

Nationally, out of 10,010 total patient pathways, 52.6% (5,267 patients) initiated treatment within four months prior to diagnosis, while 47.4% (4,743 patients) started within 30 days after discharge [^src1]. When comparing the regional distribution, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] leads in the proportion of patients treated before diagnosis, with 56.7% (1,304 out of 2,299 patients) receiving treatment within the four-month pre-diagnosis window [^src1]. Conversely, [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] trails in pre-diagnosis treatment initiation at 47.1% (1,152 out of 2,445 patients) [^src1]. 

Notably, [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] stands out as an outlier in the dataset: it is the only region where the majority of patients (52.9%, or 1,293 patients) initiated treatment within 30 days after discharge rather than before diagnosis [^src1]. In all other regions, including [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] (47.2% post-discharge), [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] (46.7%), [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] (45.6%), and [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] (43.3%), the majority of patients were treated prior to their formal diagnosis [^src1]. Because the regional data is drawn from a single reporting period, no longitudinal trends regarding improvement or decline in treatment timeliness can be established from this comparison alone.
